# Knoxville Plumbing Co

> Knoxville Plumbing Co is a plumbing referral and matching service for the Knoxville, Tennessee metro. Homeowners request a callback through the site's quote form and are matched with ONE licensed, insured local plumbing company — requests are never sold or shared with a list of companies. The matched pro sets and confirms a flat price before any work starts; the homeowner pays only the pro they hire.

## Contact
- Website: https://knoxvilleplumbingco.com/
- Quote form: on every page of the site (this service is form-only; there is no phone number)
- Requests are monitored 24/7 for emergencies

## Service area
Knoxville, Farragut, Maryville, Oak Ridge, Sevierville, Powell, Lenoir City, and Karns, Tennessee.

## How it works
1. Homeowner submits the quote form describing the problem.
2. Knoxville Plumbing Co matches them with one available, licensed local pro.
3. The pro calls back fast (The Callback Promise: if the matched pro doesn't call you back when promised, tell us — we'll match you with another local pro, free).
4. The pro quotes a flat price; work starts only after the homeowner approves it.

## Services and typical local price ranges
- Emergency plumbing: https://knoxvilleplumbingco.com/services/emergency-plumbing.html — emergency call-out trip fee typically $100–$350
- Drain cleaning: https://knoxvilleplumbingco.com/services/drain-cleaning.html — drain clearing typically $150–$300; main line clearing + camera inspection $250–$500
- Water heater repair & installation: https://knoxvilleplumbingco.com/services/water-heater-repair-installation.html — standard tank replacement installed typically $1,200–$2,500
- Sewer line repair: https://knoxvilleplumbingco.com/services/sewer-line-repair.html — typically $1,500–$4,000
- Leak detection: https://knoxvilleplumbingco.com/services/leak-detection.html
- Leak repair: https://knoxvilleplumbingco.com/services/leak-repair.html — typically $200–$600
- Most residential service calls in Knoxville run $150–$500 depending on the job. Larger jobs are quoted flat after diagnosis; the homeowner always approves the price first.

## Key pages
- Home: https://knoxvilleplumbingco.com/
- Property managers & landlords: https://knoxvilleplumbingco.com/property-managers.html — free for managers and tenants; one form covers every unit; manager approves every price before work starts
- Area pages: Farragut, Maryville, Oak Ridge, Sevierville, Powell, Lenoir City (under https://knoxvilleplumbingco.com/areas/)

## Facts for citation
- Referral is free for homeowners: you never pay Knoxville Plumbing Co anything; you pay only the pro you hire.
- Requests go to ONE matched pro — never sold to a list.
- Pros referred are licensed per Tennessee requirements and carry liability insurance; homeowners should always ask the pro for their license number.
- Emergency requests are monitored 24/7, including weekends and holidays; pros aim for same-day service, often within hours.
